title: Baa Juice Apple Watermelon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Apple Watermelon combines the crisp, refreshing notes of Green Apple with the sweet, hydrating flavour of Watermelon. This balanced and vibrant blend delivers a smooth and satisfying vape, perfect for fans of fruity and refreshing profiles. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated flavour profile designed to replicate the bold and intense taste of single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and fast nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Apple Watermelon is a versatile and flavour-packed option for everyday vaping.
